items.description:
Set in a high-rise building, Mercure Antwerp City South is located in Antwerp’s business district, with easy access to the ring road and the city centre. The hotel features a free gym with sauna. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel.

Decorated with warm colours and soft textures, all spacious rooms at Mercure Antwerp City South are fitted with king-size bedding. They all include a flat-screen TV while some include access to the Executive Lounge.

The breakfast buffet is served in Pierre which overlooks the Hertoghe Park. During the warmer months food is served on the summer terrace. Local beers, cocktails and drinks are served at Brasserie Coubertin until midnight. Mercure Antwerp City South has it's own parking garage, upon availability only.

There is a tram stop just in front of the hotel, reaching the centre in 10 minutes. The Antwerp Express Shuttle service stops a 5 minutes' walk away and provides a direct connection to Brussels Airport. hostInfo.welcomeMessage:
Large, bright and well equipped apartments for both short and long term rentals. In the very heart of the city of Antwerp you are not further than 5 minutes walking distance to the cathedral. Staying in the Nationalestraat which is one of the most central, worth-seeing streets of Antwerp. Well isolated, so no noise coming from outside. Large windows, high ceilings and wooden floors give you a real house-charming feeling. A historical building, in the center of Antwerp gives you a real taste of the "locals life".

For the fit people ; We have a co working with the best gym of antwerp called "THEBRICK". They have 4 locations, our guests can use their services, group lessons and wellness included in your booking. You will receive daily passes from us, that way we can help you stay fit during your stay! Kindly ask us if you would like to use the gym that way we can prepare the cards for you.
hostInfo.ownerInfo:
Welcome to SLEEP INN Antwerp!

We profile ourself as an Aparthotel, to offer tourists, city hoppers and expats all-inclusive apartments on the best locations in Antwerp to explore the city.

Whether you arere in Antwerp alone, as a couple for a citytrip or a family our accomodations have all the necessary you would need during your stay for both long and shortterm rentals.

You will not have to worry about taxi fares, there are plenty of busses and trams to explore the city also we are just in walking distance of the central station.
hostInfo.neighboorhoodInfo:
"Fashion & Coutoure"
Antwerp's reputation in the fashion world is on the upswing due to the designers found on Nationalestraat. Antwerp shares many similarities with London and Paris, and Nationalestraat is one of the few places that has showrooms from world-class designers like Veronique Branquinho and Yohji Yamamoto. The lack of pretensions makes it easy to forget the high status of this unassuming road. Instead of meeting high noses and fancy cars, visitors will see that smiles and bicycles are common here. The city is very passionate about educating the casual tourist about the world of design and you can do that at one of the most celebrated fashion museums, the MOMU, which is located right on this street.

Rooms at P6 Antwerp include a TV and some of them have views of Antwerp's Cathedral. All guest rooms have a private bathroom.

Experience the elegance of Botanic Sanctuary Antwerp, Antwerp’s first member of Leading Hotels of the World and your landmark 5-star superior hotel where historic charm meets modern luxury.

- Immerse yourself in upscale experiences, from culinary delights to luxurious stays in our suites. Relax in our Health & Spa Club or explore exclusive boutiques. Whether you seek a serene moment of relaxation or a grand celebration, our top-tier hospitality guarantees a luxurious yet laid-back atmosphere, seamlessly blending tradition with innovation. Enjoy the convenience of our 24-hour front desk and complimentary Wi-Fi throughout your stay.

- Experience unparalleled luxury and serenity in our 108 rooms and suites, seamlessly integrated within a 15th-century historical monastery complex. Each room and suite are housed within heritage buildings, offering exquisite furnishings, stunning views, and top-notch amenities, including private saunas and whirlpools.

- Every unit is equipped with air conditioning, a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a kettle, a shower, a hairdryer, and a desk. Additionally, all rooms come with a wardrobe and a private bathroom for your comfort and convenience during your stay at the hotel.

Situated within a 15th-century historical monastery complex, our sanctuary boasts four gastronomic restaurants, each helmed by a Michelin-starred chef, ensuring an unparalleled dining experience.

- Escape to the tranquility of Botanic Health Spa & Club, located within Antwerp’s enchanting Botanical Garden, where the serenity of nature harmonizes with state-of-the-art wellness therapies aimed at enhancing your well-being and balance. Delight in our indoor pool, hammam, saunas, and fully equipped fitness center, offering a holistic retreat for mind, body, and spirit.

- Explore Antwerp's attractions like Rubenshuis, Meir, and Groenplaats, and let us elevate your stay with our paid airport shuttle service. Nestled just steps away from Antwerp Central Station, ZOO Antwerp, Flanders Meeting & Convention Center, and the bustling main shopping streets. Our boutique hotel invites you to experience Antwerp in unparalleled comfort and style.

Discover the epitome of modern luxury in our 82 meticulously designed rooms, adorned with oak features and contemporary accents. Indulge in the details with an Espresso coffee machine, a flat-screen TV, a rejuvenating walk-in shower, and the exquisite touch of MOOOI toiletries. Stay seamlessly connected with complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the hotel and in every guest room.

Enjoy your morning with our delicious American breakfast buffet. Dive into an amazing breakfast filled with delightful flavors, tasty surprises, and all your favorite classics. We offer waffles, cereals, smoothies, soy products, fresh salmon, pastries, fruits, yoghurt, a large variety of cold cuts and so much more. There are also gluten-free options. At our Be Twisted restaurant, where good food meets a playful twist we keep it beautifully simple but never boring: a thoughtfully limited selection of dishes, served with love and perfectly paired with our fantastic range of Belgian beers.

Book your stay with us and unlock the door to an unforgettable Antwerp experience. Embrace the allure of Hotel Indigo Antwerp - City Centre, where contemporary elegance meets timeless hospitality. Your adventure begins here!
